notes: WISPDMX first science run (Oct-Nov 2017) searched for hidden photon dark matter using a tunable RF cavity with 500 MHz broadband recording. Exclusion limits derived from resonant modes (TM010, TE111−1, TE111−2, TM020) at 10^−13 level and broadband search at 10^−12 level for 0.2–2.07 µeV range, increasing below 0.2 µeV. One candidate signal found at 0.901648 µeV with coupling ~1.1×10^−12 but deemed spurious after broader spectral inspection. Local DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm³ assumed per standard halo model. Cavity volume V = 447 L. Measurements span 0.4 neV to 2.07 µeV mass range. | selector: text (sole candidate)
